newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent market closed on Monday for holiday.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent market closed on Monday for holiday.

text.p: The Brent crude futures market on the Singapore International Monetary Exchange (SIMEX) was closed on Monday to mark a U.K. holiday.
The SIMEX Brent market follows the U.K. calendar because trading in Singapore is mutually offset with trading on the bigger International Petroleum Exchange in London.
U.K. financial markets are closed on Monday to mark Spring Bank holiday.
SIMEX Brent trading resumes on Tuesday between the usual hours of 0125 and 0858 GMT.
